title: Clopen refinements are cofinal among pointed etale neighbourhoods
statement: Let $K$ be a separably closed field [def-pc-separably-closed], let $C$ be a commutative $K$-algebra, and put $E=\operatorname{Spec}C$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Assume that for every prime $z\subset C$ the structural map $K\to C_z$ is an isomorphism, where $C_z$ denotes localization at the complement of $z$. Assume also that clopen subsets form a basis of $E$: for every open $U\subseteq E$ and $z\in U$ there is an open and closed $W$ with $z\in W\subseteq U$. Fix any geometric point $\bar z:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to E$ [def-weil-geometric-point] lying over $z$. For every pointed etale neighbourhood $(V,\bar v)$ of $\bar z$ [def-weil-pbc-pointed-etale-neighbourhoods], there are a clopen neighbourhood $W\subseteq E$ of $z$ and an $E$-morphism $b:W\to V$ satisfying $b\circ\bar z_W=\bar v$, where $\bar z_W$ is the unique factorization of $\bar z$ through $W$. Given two clopen neighbourhoods $W_1,W_2$ of $z$ and pointed $E$-morphisms $b_i:W_i\to V$, there is a clopen neighbourhood $W_3\subseteq W_1\cap W_2$ of $z$ on which $b_1$ and $b_2$ agree. Thus the clopen pointed neighbourhoods form an initial subsystem of the pointed etale neighbourhoods. Each clopen $W$ is $D(e)=\operatorname{Spec}C_e$ for an idempotent $e\in C$, with its open-subscheme structure, where $C_e$ is localization at $e$.
